# owner=user ruling (coordinator file, env_0083)

An `owner=user` gold call must be a write the fleet's authorized contact makes in person over the fleet's own affairs, where the business semantics genuinely require the customer rather than the agent. Accepted kinds:
(a) **The customer's own instruction or attestation through the self-service channel**, as a `by: user` transition and its same-category consequence: e.g. an authorized account administrator submitting a signed dispute / fraud affidavit, accepting a changed credit line or terms, confirming a card cancellation or driver termination, setting a purchase-control change only an administrator may authorize. The policy's own rule states why the customer must do it (signature, attestation, administrator authority) and the persona holds that role.
(b) **A payment the account's authorized payer makes from the fleet's own bank account through secure self-service** (one-time ACH / payment portal). Agents never take bank account or card numbers over the phone; the rule says so and the persona can make the payment.
(c) **The customer's own deposit or collateral** (funding a security deposit / prepayment).

Rejected: a label-only "the customer places the request" where nothing in the rule or business requires the customer in person and the agent could equally write it; any user tool whose parameter is a reference number the action itself produces; a user call whose figures the customer could not know without the agent telling them, unless the agent tells them before the hand-over.
